use default

eban_group(group: int) -> bool =>
    (let (tens, units) = (group / 10, group % 10)
    let eban_units = units == 0 \/ units == 2 \/
        units == 4 \/ units == 6
    let eban_tens = tens == 0 \/ tens == 3 \/ tens == 4 \/
        tens == 5 \/ tens == 6
    group == 0 \/
        group < 100 /\ eban_units /\ eban_tens)

groups(n: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let remaining mut = n

    while remaining > 0 do

        remaining = remaining / 1000
    od
si

is_eban(n: int) -> bool => groups(n) |> all(eban_group)

eban_up_to(limit: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    stream(1, n => n || n + 1) |> take(limit) |> filter(is_eban)

let up_to_1000 = eban_up_to(1000) |> collect()
